mag.season.24.issueTitle: 百场与三百场：小组收官特辑
mag.season.24.issueTitleEn: One Hundred, Three Hundred: Group Finale Special

pages.headline: 给他十米空间，你最好直接犯规
pages.headlineEn: Give Him Ten Yards? Just Foul Him
pages.deck: 小组赛收官夜，经验被重新标价。
pages.deckEn: Group-stage finale: experience gets repriced.
pages.bodyLeft: 安德烈·卡瓦略的葡超第一百场之后没有太多仪式，只有对手边后卫赛后主动来换球衣——据说是留作警示后人的教具。三场完整录像里，他的内切线路每次都一样，每次都拦不住。
pages.bodyLeftEn: André Carvalho's 100th league game passed without ceremony — only an opposing full-back asked for the shirt, kept as a warning exhibit. Three full tapes: same cut-in, every time, never stopped.
pages.bodyRight: 另一边的托马斯·格兰特正在准备英冠第三百场之后的又一场比赛。冲刺数据不再吓人，但更衣室里的分贝统计依旧全队第一。小组赛末段，这两种履历同时开始升值。
pages.bodyRightEn: Thomas Grant readies for the game after his 300th in the Championship. Sprint stats no longer scare; dressing-room decibels still top the squad. Late in the group, both CVs are rising.
pages.pullQuote: “出场数不会骗人，前提是它真的有出场数可查。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Appearance counts don't lie — if there are any to count.”
pages.sidebarBody: 一百场：查赛程。三百场：查赛程。至于赛季初那份“四十一球”：先查是哪个联赛。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: 100 games: check fixtures. 300: check fixtures. That '41 goals': first check which league.

pages.headline: 小组赛最后一轮，算术题比战术板厚
pages.headlineEn: Final Round: The Sums Outweigh the Tactics Board
pages.deck: 出线、排位与轮换之间，教练先做数学。
pages.deckEn: Qualify, seed, rotate — the manager does maths first.
pages.bodyLeft: 小组赛最后一轮的教练席像一间临时会计事务所：这边领先一个够不够，那边净胜球要不要追，替补席上人人都在心算，连第四官员举牌都像在报汇率。经验球员的价值在这九十分钟里不是跑动，而是让全队别在第 75 分钟集体掏出计算器。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The final-round dugout is a pop-up accountancy firm: is one goal enough, do we chase goal difference, everyone doing sums while the fourth official's board flashes like an exchange rate. A veteran's value isn't running — it's stopping the squad reaching for calculators in the 75th minute.
pages.bodyRight: 末轮还有一种暗战：领先的一方练习控制，落后的一方练习梭哈。前者需要有人把节奏降下来、把球护住、把犯规挑在对的位置；后者需要有人相信九十分钟够用。两种活都不上集锦，两种活都决定谁继续上班、谁开始解释赛制。
pages.bodyRightEn: The last round hides a cold war: leaders rehearse control, chasers rehearse all-in. One needs tempo slowed, ball shielded, fouls well placed; the other, belief that 90 minutes is enough. Neither makes the highlights; both decide who keeps working and who explains the format.
pages.pullQuote: “末轮最重要的技术动作，是把比分牌看住。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The decisive final-round technique: keep your eyes on the scoreboard.”
pages.sidebarBody: 同时偷看另一块场地的比分；第 80 分钟全员心算净胜球；赛后发布会准备两套稿子。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Sneaking looks at the other score; mass goal-difference sums on 80 minutes; two presser drafts prepared.

pages.headline: 卡瓦略：反击里的猎鹰，落位后的问号
pages.headlineEn: Carvalho: The Falcon on the Break, a Question Mark When Settled
pages.deck: 一百场样本可信，使用说明书要配空间。
pages.deckEn: The 100-game sample holds up; the manual requires space.
pages.bodyLeft: 优势清清楚楚：葡超出场破百、欧战见过场面，爆发力是即插即用的那种。三场完整录像里，他的内切线路几乎不换花样，防守者知道他要干什么，还是拦不住。由守转攻时，他是那种让中后卫提前后悔站位的边锋。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Strengths are plain: 100+ Portuguese top-flight games, European experience, plug-and-play pace. Three tapes, one cut-in — defenders know it's coming and still can't stop it. In transition he makes centre-backs regret their positioning early.
pages.bodyRight: 问号也清楚：阵地战里对方边后卫不退半步时，他的样本明显变薄；无球防守投入度随比分起伏。而“给他十米空间你最好直接犯规”的另一面是——越来越多对手真的选择了犯规，他制造定位球后的出勤率需要单独核查。
pages.bodyRightEn: Questions are plain too: when a full-back won't drop an inch, his sample thins; off-ball defending tracks the scoreline. And the flip side of 'ten yards, just foul' — opponents increasingly do, so his availability after the set-pieces he wins needs its own check.
pages.pullQuote: “给他空间是你的失误，不给他空间是你的工作。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Give him space: your mistake. Deny him space: your job.”
pages.sidebarBody: 反击体系、边路纵深、有中锋牵制。避免：全场围攻却无人能拉开宽度的阵地战。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Counter-attack system, wing depth, a striker to pin. Avoid: long sieges with no width.

pages.headline: 格兰特：三百场换来的嗓门
pages.headlineEn: Grant: The Voice 300 Games Bought
pages.deck: 领导力可以折算成多少积分，目前没人算清。
pages.deckEn: How many points is leadership worth? Nobody has done the maths.
pages.bodyLeft: 三百场英冠不是履历，是一部可以分集核查的纪录片：防线指挥、定位球站位、更衣室秩序，全部有多年录像和多位前队友的交叉证词。升级赛季他在场，保级泥潭赛季他也在场——后者往往更能说明一个队长的成色。
pages.bodyLeftEn: 300 Championship games: not a CV but an auditable documentary — defensive command, set-piece shape, dressing-room order, all on years of tape and ex-teammate testimony. He was there for promotion and for the relegation mire; the latter says more about a captain.
pages.bodyRight: 风险写在体测单上：转身和回追已经不适合高位防线，连续一周双赛需要轮换配额，定位球防守里他更适合指挥而不是盯人。报价前请只用本赛季录像评估他的速度，不要用他自己的回忆，也不要用对手赛后的客气。
pages.bodyRightEn: Risks are on the fitness sheet: turning and chasing no longer suit a high line; two games a week need rotation; at defensive set-pieces he conducts better than he marks. Judge pace on this season's tape — not his memoirs, not opponents' politeness.
pages.pullQuote: “队长袖标不能回追，但能让别人提前回追。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The armband can't chase back, but it makes others chase sooner.”
pages.sidebarBody: 高位防线勿试；连续客场需轮换；速度评价请以今年录像为准，勿引用回忆录。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: No high line; rotate on away runs; pace verdicts from this year's tape — no memoirs.

mag.season.26.issueTitle: 冬歇体检号：铁人标准与亲戚条款
mag.season.26.issueTitleEn: Winter Medicals: Iron Men and the Uncle Clause

pages.headline: 冬歇体检报告：铁人标准与亲戚条款
pages.headlineEn: Winter Medicals: Iron-Man Standards and the Uncle Clause
pages.deck: 假期结束，体测仪器和推荐电话一起响了。
pages.deckEn: Holidays over; machines and recommendation calls ring at once.
pages.bodyLeft: 菲利普·诺瓦克的冬歇体检据说只用了别人一半的时间——仪器找不到多余的东西可测，就像他的比赛里没有多余的动作。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Filip Novak's winter medical reportedly took half the usual time — the machines found nothing extra to measure, much as his game has no spare movement.
pages.bodyRight: 同期抵达事务所的还有一份由叔叔亲自递交的简历。封面写着“从小看着长大”，附件是一顿规格过高的家庭烧烤邀请函。冬歇期的球探工作，一半是读数，一半是读人。
pages.bodyRightEn: Also arriving: a CV hand-delivered by an uncle, cover line 'watched him grow up', attachment an alarmingly lavish barbecue invitation. Winter scouting: half numbers, half people.
pages.pullQuote: “体检报告只回答身体问题，回答不了他叔叔是谁。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A medical answers questions about the body, not about his uncle.”
pages.sidebarBody: 体脂、冲刺、心率、假期训练记录。亲属推荐信请移步另一个窗口。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Body fat, sprints, heart rate, holiday training logs. Family references: next window.

pages.headline: 铁人不是不受伤，是受伤记录可以查
pages.headlineEn: Iron Men Do Get Injured — Their Injuries Are on File
pages.deck: 全勤类的传说，请先从病历夹看起。
pages.deckEn: For ever-present legends, start with the medical folder.
pages.bodyLeft: 冬歇体检的正确打开方式是翻旧账：连续出场纪录要和伤病记录对着看，“异常健康”的结论要有医院抬头和日期。铁人标准第一条不是从不受伤，而是每次小伤都有完整的回归时间表。凡是体检报告比简历还薄的候选人，都值得多问一句：这些年你都在哪儿做的检查？
pages.bodyLeftEn: A winter medical is an audit: streaks against injury records, 'abnormally healthy' verdicts on hospital letterheads. Iron-man rule one isn't never getting hurt — it's a return timeline for every knock. If the file is thinner than the CV, ask where he's been getting checked.
pages.bodyRight: 与体检报告一起抵达的，还有亲戚条款类推荐。每逢窗口，“从小看着长大”的证明材料就准时加厚。本刊立场不变：亲属可以推荐，但不能作证。上一份由叔叔转交的影像资料里，关键画面被一块三明治挡住了号码；这一份，我们建议至少把三明治挪开再评估。
pages.bodyRightEn: Then come the uncle-clause recommendations. Every window, the 'watched him grow up' dossiers thicken on schedule. Our stance: relatives may recommend, not testify. Last uncle-delivered footage had the number blocked by a sandwich; this time, move the sandwich first.
pages.pullQuote: “全勤是一种能力，前提是打卡机没让别人代按。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Ever-present is an ability — if nobody else punched the clock for him.”
pages.sidebarBody: 出场记录→伤病记录→训练出勤→推荐人与球员的确切亲属关系。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Appearances → injuries → training attendance → exact family relation of the recommender.

pages.headline: 诺瓦克：没有多余动作的人
pages.headlineEn: Novak: The Man With No Spare Movements
pages.deck: 国家队履历可查，节奏稳定得像校准过。
pages.deckEn: The international record checks out; the tempo seems factory-calibrated.
pages.bodyLeft: 看诺瓦克的录像像看一份校准证书：传球稳定，节奏感极好，几乎找不到多余动作。国家队预选赛出场记录真实可查，说明高压客场里也有人信任他。冬歇后的体测干净，假期训练记录完整——在这个行业，“完整”已经是稀缺品质。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Novak's tape reads like a calibration certificate: steady passing, fine rhythm, no wasted motion. National-team qualifying appearances verifiable — someone trusts him in tough away games. Clean medical, complete training log; 'complete' is rare in this trade.
pages.bodyRight: 疑问同样具体：绝对速度一般，被逼抢时向前的意愿需要更多样本；节奏型球员换一个联赛，最先丢的往往不是技术而是熟悉的拍点。建议试训安排一场高强度对抗，专门观察他被贴身之后的第一脚。
pages.bodyRightEn: Doubts too: outright pace is ordinary; forward intent under pressure needs more samples. A rhythm player changing leagues first loses the beat, not the technique. Run one high-intensity trial; watch his first pass once marked tight.
pages.pullQuote: “他的录像像钟表说明书——准确，但请确认你要的是钟表。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “His tape reads like a clock manual — accurate, but confirm you wanted a clock.”
pages.sidebarBody: 接球前观察次数；由守转攻第一脚方向；被贴身后的处理。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Scans before receiving; first pass after regains; handling when marked tight.

pages.headline: 小莫雷拉：亲戚条款年度测试案例
pages.headlineEn: Moreira the Cousin: The Uncle Clause's Annual Test Case
pages.deck: 简历很短，家庭关系很长。
pages.deckEn: A very short CV with very long family ties.
pages.bodyLeft: 先说能核实的：年轻，训练准点——叔叔负责接送；热情真实，工资要求处于市场地下室。试训里的无球跑动出人意料地积极，至少在追逐每一个球这件事上，他没有亲戚可以代劳。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Verifiable: young, punctual (the uncle drives), genuinely keen, wages in the market's basement. His trial off-ball running was unexpectedly eager — chasing every ball is one job no relative can do for him.
pages.bodyRight: 其余全是空白：没有正式比赛样本，唯一推荐人是叔叔，“给他个机会绝对能行”不构成战术分析。号码可见性未经核实，家庭烧烤出席记录不能折算成出场分钟。建议开放试训、关闭偏见，并把评估表与烧烤邀请函分开存档。
pages.bodyRightEn: The rest is blank: no senior sample, the only referee is the uncle, and 'give him a chance' is not tactical analysis. Barbecue attendance doesn't convert into minutes. Open the trial, close the bias; file the assessment separately from the invitation.
pages.pullQuote: “每个天才都曾是某人的侄子，但不是每个侄子都是天才。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Every genius was somebody's nephew; not every nephew is a genius.”
pages.sidebarBody: 先看他踢球，再吃烤肉。两个场合请安排在不同日期。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Watch him play first, eat the barbecue second — on different dates.

mag.season.28.issueTitle: 冬窗开讯号：检点问题与最年轻纪录
mag.season.28.issueTitleEn: Window Opener: The 'Conduct' Column and the Youngest Record

pages.headline: 冬窗开张：新简历多了“检点”一栏
pages.headlineEn: The Window Opens: CVs Now Carry a 'Conduct' Column
pages.deck: 里纳尔迪的直塞没有争议，争议在球场以外。
pages.deckEn: Rinaldi's through balls brook no argument; the argument is off the pitch.
pages.bodyLeft: 马泰奥·里纳尔迪的传球录像让三家俱乐部同时拿起电话，他的场外传闻又让其中两家同时放下。冬窗第一周的共识是：先定义什么叫“检点”，再谈价格。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Matteo Rinaldi's passing tape had three clubs reaching for the phone; his off-field rumours had two hang up. Week one's consensus: define 'conduct' first, then talk price.
pages.bodyRight: 同一个清晨，卢卡斯·莫雷尔的最年轻纪录旧闻被重新翻出。纪录本身没有变化，变化的是冬窗给它贴的价格标签。开窗第一天，所有人都在给风险重新命名。
pages.bodyRightEn: The same morning, Lucas Morel's youngest-ever record resurfaced. The record hasn't moved; the price tag the window sticks on it has. Day one: everyone renaming risk.
pages.pullQuote: “传闻不能首发，但传闻能影响排兵布阵的胆量。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Rumours can't start a match; they can still spook the team sheet.”
pages.sidebarBody: 传闻分级、纪录核查、传真机预热。后两者有文件，前者只有语气。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Rumour grading, record checks, fax warm-up. Two have documents; one has only a tone of voice.

pages.headline: 里纳尔迪：不用抬头的直塞，需要抬头的管理层
pages.headlineEn: Rinaldi: No-Look Through Balls, a Boardroom That Must Look Up
pages.deck: U21 核心能力可信，场外部分请走核查流程。
pages.deckEn: The U21 core ability is credible; the off-field part needs due diligence.
pages.bodyLeft: 先说足球部分，因为足球部分几乎没有争议：直塞球和禁区前沿处理是同龄段顶级，U21 核心地位有多场大赛录像支撑。“传球之前甚至不用抬头”不是玄学，是提前扫描的习惯——录像里他接球前的回头观察次数，比很多中场整场的都多。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Football first, as it's barely disputed: through balls and edge-of-box craft are best in his age group, U21 status backed by big-match tape. 'Passes without looking up' is a scanning habit, not myth — he checks his shoulder more per move than some midfielders per match.
pages.bodyRight: 再说球场以外：传闻目前只是传闻，本刊不刊登细节，只建议买方走标准核查——训练出勤、客场纪律、教练访谈。真正需要评估的不是八卦内容，而是管理层应对媒体放大的预案。绯闻不上场，但绯闻会上头条。
pages.bodyRightEn: Beyond football: the rumours stay rumours, we print no details; buyers run standard checks — training attendance, away discipline, manager interviews. Assess not the gossip but the club's plan for media storms. Scandal doesn't play; scandal headlines.
pages.pullQuote: “手术刀负责切开防线，管理层负责别让自己先失血。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The Scalpel opens defences; the boardroom's job is not to bleed first.”
pages.sidebarBody: 训练出勤记录、教练访谈、客场纪律记录。八卦版面仅供预警，不作结论。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Training attendance, manager interviews, away discipline. Gossip pages: early warning, not verdict.

pages.headline: 莫雷尔：纪录是真的，样本还是少年的
pages.headlineEn: Morel: The Record Is Real, the Sample Still a Boy's
pages.deck: 最年轻出场纪录已核实，成年对抗仍在加载。
pages.deckEn: Youngest-ever debut verified; senior duels still loading.
pages.bodyLeft: 影锋的本能是天生的那种：他喜欢从前锋身后突然插进禁区，启动时机的选择远超年龄。青年国脚身份属实，最年轻出场纪录经文件核实属实——在本赛季的信息环境里，“属实”两个字值得单独加粗。
pages.bodyLeftEn: His shadow-striker instinct is the born kind: darting in from behind the forwards, timing beyond his age. Youth international status genuine, youngest-ever record verified by documents — this season, 'verified' earns its own bold type.
pages.bodyRight: 但请把纪录和结论分开：一线队样本仍然很小，成年对抗、连续作战和身体发育都在加载中。纪录带来溢价，溢价带来“必须立刻用他”的压力——对少年球员来说，这比任何中卫都危险。分钟数上限和保护计划，请写进合同附件。
pages.bodyRightEn: Keep record and conclusion apart: the senior sample is tiny, adult contact and growth still loading. Records bring premiums; premiums bring 'play him now' pressure — deadlier to a teenager than any centre-back. Minute caps and a protection plan belong in the annexes.
pages.pullQuote: “最年轻的纪录说明他开始得早，不说明他已经到终点。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A youngest-ever record says he started early, not that he has arrived.”
pages.sidebarBody: 分钟数上限、连续首发限制、媒体隔离。少年球员的赛程表需要成年人签字。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Minute caps, start limits, media shielding. A teenager's schedule needs an adult's signature.

pages.headline: “最年轻”三个字为什么总要附一页出生证明
pages.headlineEn: Why 'Youngest Ever' Always Ships With a Birth Certificate
pages.deck: 纪录核查入门：先有文件，再有标题。
pages.deckEn: Record verification 101: documents first, headline second.
pages.bodyLeft: 核查一条“最年轻纪录”需要三份文件：出生证明、注册时间、当场比赛的出场名单。本月这份纪录三份齐全，可以写。对比本赛季早些时候那份著名的“四十一球”——没有联赛名称、没有出场数、没有比赛级别——读者现在应该能自己分辨什么叫纪录，什么叫数字装饰。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Verifying a 'youngest ever' takes three documents: birth certificate, registration date, the match teamsheet. This month's record has all three — write it up. Compare the famous '41 goals': no league, no appearances, no level. Readers can now tell a record from a decorative number.
pages.bodyRight: 冬窗是纪录通胀的重灾区。每开一扇窗，“最年轻”就自动细分出队史版、联赛版、客场版和周二下午版。本刊建议的读法是：先找限定词，再找原始文件，最后才看价格标签。限定词越多，纪录越多；附件越薄，标题越大。买方的自查也很简单：如果你只能用标题复述这笔签约，请先别签字。
pages.bodyRightEn: The winter window is where records inflate: 'youngest' subdivides into club, league, away and Tuesday-afternoon editions. Reading order: qualifiers, then source documents, price tag last. More qualifiers, more records; thinner annexes, bigger headlines. Buyer's self-check: if you can only recite the signing via its headline, don't sign.
pages.pullQuote: “先问纪录全称，再问价格。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Ask the record's full name before asking the price.”
pages.sidebarBody: “之一”两个字通常藏在第五段；“队史最年轻”和“联赛最年轻”差着一个档案馆。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: 'One of the' usually hides in paragraph five; between 'club youngest' and 'league youngest' lies an archive.

mag.season.29.issueTitle: 冬窗淘金号：被放弃者市场指南
mag.season.29.issueTitleEn: Winter Gold Rush: A Guide to the Discarded

pages.headline: 被大俱乐部放弃的人，正在小俱乐部首发
pages.headlineEn: Dropped by Big Clubs, Starting for Small Ones
pages.deck: 淘金指南第一条：放弃理由比放弃人数重要。
pages.deckEn: Gold-panning rule one: the reason for the discard beats the headcount.
pages.bodyLeft: 每年一月，自由球员名单都会变厚。有人因为年龄，有人因为体系，还有人因为新教练喜欢另一种足球。名单本身不回答问题，它只是问题的目录。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Every January the free-agent list thickens — age, system, or a new manager's taste. The list answers nothing; it's a table of contents of questions.
pages.bodyRight: 淘金者的原则是把“被放弃”拆成三种：能力、伤病、不匹配。只有前两种会写进球探报告，第三种常常写着写着就成了捡漏。
pages.bodyRightEn: Split 'discarded' into ability, injury, mismatch. Only the first two belong in reports; the third often becomes a bargain.
pages.pullQuote: “别人放弃的原因，决定你捡到的价格。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Why they let him go sets the price you pick him up for.”
pages.sidebarBody: 为什么走？谁的判断？有没有第二家俱乐部犯了同样的错？
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Why did he leave? Whose call? Has a second club made the same mistake?

pages.headline: 自由身市场：便宜是最贵的筛选条件
pages.headlineEn: Free Market: 'Cheap' Is the Dearest Filter
pages.deck: 零转会费不等于零成本，签字费和工资都在排队。
pages.deckEn: Zero fee isn't zero cost; bonuses and wages are queuing.
pages.bodyLeft: 自由身市场的标语是“零转会费”，账单不是：签字费、佣金、工资一样不少，只是换了付款名目。真正的筛选在体检室。有的老将行李里只有一只保温杯，那是好兆头——说明他清楚自己的膝盖需要什么，并且已经和膝盖和解多年。真正要警惕的，是连体检预约都想改期的人。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The free market's slogan is 'no fee'; the invoice disagrees — bonus, commission, wages, all renamed. The real filter is the medical. A veteran whose luggage is one thermos flask is a good sign: he knows what his knees need and made peace with them years ago. Fear the man who asks to reschedule the medical.
pages.bodyRight: 被放弃者分两种：带着证明自己的愤怒的，和带着被证明的疲惫的。前者在试训里追每一个二分之一球，后者在等别人先伸手。三天试训看不出全部，但看得出这个。淘金指南最后一条：愤怒会过期，疲惫会传染，签约前请确认你买的是哪一种。
pages.bodyRightEn: The discarded come in two kinds: carrying anger to prove something, or carrying the tiredness of being disproved. The first chase every fifty-fifty; the second wait for others to reach first. Three days won't show everything, but they show this. Anger expires, tiredness is contagious — know which you're buying.
pages.pullQuote: “免费球员的工资单从不免费。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A free player's wage bill is never free.”
pages.sidebarBody: 签字费、佣金、工资、体检、融入时间。最后一项没有发票，但最贵。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Bonus, commission, wages, medical, settling-in time. The last has no invoice but costs most.

pages.headline: 淘金试训模板：三天能看清什么
pages.headlineEn: The Trial Template: What Three Days Can Show
pages.deck: 短期试训的观察边界与常见错觉。
pages.deckEn: The limits of short trials, and their common illusions.
pages.bodyLeft: 三天试训能看清的事情不少：身体状态、训练态度、基本技术的成色，以及他是否还愿意做不显眼的工作——回追、补位、给年轻队友多传一脚舒服的球。“还能不能踢”这个问题，其实第二天下午就有答案。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Three days reveal plenty: condition, attitude, technique's true grade, and whether he still does invisible work — chasing back, covering, feeding young teammates comfortable passes. 'Can he still play?' is answered by day two's afternoon.
pages.bodyRight: 看不清的是另一半：战术理解需要正式比赛，抗压需要比分落后，性格需要一次冲突。试训表现好不等于比赛表现好，新环境人人都有三天蜜月。建议用短约加条款对冲，把判断权留一部分给春天。
pages.bodyRightEn: Hidden: tactical understanding needs real matches, composure a deficit, character a confrontation. A good trial ≠ a good match player; new places grant three-day honeymoons. Hedge with a short deal plus clauses; leave some judgement to spring.
pages.pullQuote: “试训能验证怀疑，不能替代怀疑。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A trial can test your doubts, not replace them.”
pages.sidebarBody: 短约优先；出场条款挂钩；冬窗签约请给春天下调空间。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Short deal first; appearance clauses; leave room for a spring downgrade.

pages.headline: 为什么他一穿我们球衣就不会踢了
pages.headlineEn: Why Can't He Play Once He Wears Our Shirt?
pages.deck: 冬窗签约的蜜月期与退货期。
pages.deckEn: The honeymoon and the returns window of January signings.
pages.bodyLeft: 为什么他一穿我们球衣就不会踢了？因为球员不是即插即用设备，是环境依赖型生物：体系、语言、城市、更衣室座位、训练场离家的距离，每一项都能吃掉他一成的状态。冬窗买家最常犯的错误，是只评估了球员，没有评估自己提供的环境。环境评估并不比球员评估便宜，但它比解约便宜。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Why can't he play in our shirt? A player isn't plug-and-play; he's environment-dependent: system, language, city, dressing-room seat, commute — each eats a tenth of his form. The January buyer's classic error: assessing the player, not the environment on offer. An environment audit costs no less than a player audit, but less than a pay-off.
pages.bodyRight: 解决方案朴素得像说明书：明确角色、安排融入、给他一个能听懂他玩笑的队友。新援见面会的细节也请注意——球衣展示环节，三明治请放在盘子侧边，不要挡住号码。本刊本赛季已经在遮挡物上栽过一次跟头。转会费可以分期，教训最好一次性付清。
pages.bodyRightEn: The fix is manual-plain: define the role, arrange the settling-in, find him a teammate who gets his jokes. At the shirt unveiling, the sandwich goes beside the plate, not over the number — we've tripped on an obstruction once already. Fees can be paid in instalments; lessons are best paid in full.
pages.pullQuote: “球衣不会施法，号码也不会，请把注意力放在球员身上。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Shirts cast no spells, numbers neither — kindly watch the player.”
pages.sidebarBody: 住房、翻译、战术手册页数上限、更衣室座位。发布会三明治请放盘子侧边。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Housing, interpreter, tactics-manual page cap, dressing-room seat. Sandwich beside the plate.

mag.season.30.issueTitle: 淘汰赛经济学：关键经验的价格
mag.season.30.issueTitleEn: Knockout Economics: The Price of Experience

pages.headline: “进过关键球”值多少钱一周
pages.headlineEn: What Is 'Scored Big Goals' Worth per Week?
pages.deck: 淘汰赛临近，经验开始按周计价。
pages.deckEn: As the knockouts near, experience bills by the week.
pages.bodyLeft: 卡洛斯·门德斯的经纪人把青年国脚、次级联赛金靴竞争者、顶级联赛两季排成一行，像收据一样递给每家冬窗买家。淘汰赛临近，这张收据又被复印了几份。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Carlos Mendez's agent lines up youth honours, a Golden Boot race, two top-flight seasons — receipts handed to every winter buyer. With knockouts near, they're photocopied again.
pages.bodyRight: 问题不在于这些经历是否真实——它们都可查——而在于它们能为下周的淘汰赛预支多少进球。历史可以证明能力，不能预订比分。
pages.bodyRightEn: The question isn't whether it's all real — it checks out — but how many goals it can pre-pay for next week's tie. History proves ability; it cannot book a scoreline.
pages.pullQuote: “经验是利率，不是本金。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Experience is the interest rate, not the capital.”
pages.sidebarBody: 听到“大场面”“关键先生”“见过世面”，请先调出他的浪费机会集锦。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Hearing 'big-game player', 'clutch', 'seen it all'? Pull up his missed-chances reel first.

pages.headline: 门德斯：终结者的账单与备注
pages.headlineEn: Mendez: The Terminator's Invoice and Footnotes
pages.deck: 禁区射手样本充足，效率争议同样充足。
pages.deckEn: Ample box-scoring sample; ample dispute over efficiency.
pages.bodyLeft: 禁区里的部分可以信任：抢点、单刀、第一反应射门，金靴竞争者和顶级联赛两季的经历都查得到。他的跑位不惊艳，但总出现在后卫最不想看到人的位置。淘汰赛临近，这种“正确时间出现在正确地点”的履历会被重新定价。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The box work can be trusted: poaching, one-on-ones, first-time finishes — Golden Boot race and two top-flight seasons all check out. His movement doesn't dazzle, but he keeps appearing where defenders least want anyone. This 'right place, right time' CV now gets repriced.
pages.bodyRight: 备注栏同样长：“浪费机会过多”的球迷评价需要数据复核——把他的重大机会转化率和同级射手放在一起看，别和集锦比。另外请确认他需要的输送类型：终结者的效率，一半写在自己的脚上，一半写在别人的传球里。
pages.bodyRightEn: Footnotes too: the 'wastes chances' fan verdict needs data — compare his big-chance conversion with peers, not reels. And confirm the supply he needs: a Terminator's efficiency is half his boots, half others' passes.
pages.pullQuote: “终结者的集锦很漂亮，集锦的剪辑师也很忙。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The Terminator's reel is beautiful; its editor is very busy.”
pages.sidebarBody: 每 90 分钟射门质量；重大机会转化率；强强对话样本；最近一个完整赛季。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Shot quality per 90; big-chance conversion; strong-side sample; last full season.

pages.headline: 淘汰赛经验溢价：样本小，胆子大
pages.headlineEn: The Knockout Premium: Small Sample, Bold Valuation
pages.deck: 两回合的比赛，装不下那么多结论。
pages.deckEn: Two legs cannot hold that many conclusions.
pages.bodyLeft: 淘汰赛的全部样本只有一百八十分钟，却总有人愿意为它付三年的工资。“大场面球员”的估值模型里，一次关键进球的权重高得离谱，而失误、轮空和对手红牌都被悄悄摊销。宣传话术也在升级：赛季初还是“四十一球”，如今进化为“大场面基因”——统计口径依旧缺席。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The entire knockout sample is 180 minutes, yet someone always pays three years' wages for it. In the 'big-game player' model one crucial goal carries absurd weight; errors, byes and opponents' red cards get quietly amortised. The patter has evolved too: from '41 goals' to 'big-game DNA' — methodology still absent.
pages.bodyRight: 真正值钱的经验往往不性感：客场领先后的阵型纪律、被扳平后开球的那一分钟、点球顺序表提前写好而不是现场民主表决。这些能力可以训练、可以核查、可以写进合同考核。至于“见过世面”，世面本人并未出具证明。凡是不附录像时间戳的“经验”，请先按文学作品归档。
pages.bodyRightEn: Truly valuable experience isn't sexy: shape after an away goal, the restart minute after an equaliser, a penalty order pre-written, not voted live. These can be trained, verified, contracted. As for 'seen it all' — it-all issued no certificate. 'Experience' without tape timestamps is filed under literature.
pages.pullQuote: “淘汰赛不相信平均数，它只认这一次。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Knockouts don't believe in averages, only in this one time.”
pages.sidebarBody: 客场进球后的五分钟管理；领先后的阵型纪律；点球顺序表提前写好。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: The five minutes after an away goal; discipline when ahead; penalty order pre-written.

pages.headline: 冬窗过半：价格跳水，故事涨价
pages.headlineEn: Window Halfway: Prices Dive, Stories Appreciate
pages.deck: 窗口越接近关闭，形容词越夸张。
pages.deckEn: The closer the deadline, the fancier the adjectives.
pages.bodyLeft: 冬窗进入第三周，市场规律开始显形：第一周最贵的是球员，第三周最贵的是故事。同一个名字，两周前的卖点是“战术拼图”，现在变成了“不能再错过”。价格没有变，形容词先涨了价。买方的对策只有一个：清单在开窗前写好，溢价在情绪里识别。
pages.bodyLeftEn: By week three the pattern shows: week one's dearest thing is the player; week three's is the story. The 'tactical puzzle piece' of a fortnight ago is now 'not to be missed'. Prices haven't moved; adjectives got there first. Defence: write the shortlist pre-window; spot the premium inside the emotion.
pages.bodyRight: 截止日前四十八小时，建议所有体育主管只接电话、不拨电话，并把传真机纸盒提前装满——下周你们用得上这个传统，本刊年度保留节目“卡纸”正在预热。最后提醒：恐慌不是引援策略，只是比较贵的引援策略。卖方同理：如果你只在最后一周才接到电话，请反思前三个星期。
pages.bodyRightEn: Final 48 hours: sporting directors should answer calls, never dial, and pre-fill the fax tray — you'll need that tradition next week; our annual set piece 'The Paper Jam' is warming up. Remember: panic isn't a recruitment strategy, just a dearer one. Sellers too: if the phone only rings in the last week, reflect on the three before.
pages.pullQuote: “截止日不买紧迫感，只买清单上原来就有的名字。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Deadline day: buy no urgency, only names already on the list.”
pages.sidebarBody: 清单提前定；价格上限提前定；传真机纸盒提前装满。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Shortlist early; price ceiling early; fax tray filled early.

mag.season.31.issueTitle: 关窗号：传真机卡纸年终重演
mag.season.31.issueTitleEn: Window Shut: The Annual Fax Jam

pages.headline: 冬窗关闭：传真机再次当选全场最佳
pages.headlineEn: Window Closed: The Fax Machine Wins MotM Again
pages.deck: 有人官宣，有人官宣撤回，有人研究卡纸。
pages.deckEn: Some announce, some un-announce, some study paper jams.
pages.bodyLeft: 截止夜十点，三家俱乐部宣布“完成了主要目标”，两家宣布“现有阵容才是答案”，还有一家的传真机吞掉了转会协议第二页，目前正在接受媒体采访。
pages.bodyLeftEn: 10pm: three clubs 'completed their main objectives', two found 'the current squad is the answer', and one fax machine swallowed page two of a transfer agreement. It is currently giving interviews.
pages.bodyRight: 本刊统计：四周内共有十九笔“体检接近完成”，十一笔“个人条款达成一致”，以及一位至今无人认领的“决定性签约”。冬窗结束了，形容词们开始放假。
pages.bodyRightEn: Our four-week tally: nineteen deals 'close to a medical', eleven 'personal terms agreed', one 'decisive signing' unclaimed. The window is over; the adjectives begin their holiday.
pages.pullQuote: “传真机不卡纸的冬天，才是真的新闻。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A winter without a fax jam — that would be news.”
pages.sidebarBody: 官宣若干；撤回两笔；卡纸一台；“早就在计划中”声明若干——最后这类最不可信。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Announcements: several. Retractions: two. Jams: one. 'Always the plan' claims: several — least credible.

pages.headline: 传真机卡纸简史：一部故障，半部转会史
pages.headlineEn: A Brief History of the Fax Jam: One Fault, Half of Transfer History
pages.deck: 为什么每年都有一张纸决定一个人的职业生涯。
pages.deckEn: Why one sheet of paper decides a career every year.
pages.bodyLeft: 传真机卡纸史几乎就是冬窗史：某年是一份缺签名的协议，某年是一张被当成转会文件的餐厅菜单，今年轮到了经典的第二页失踪案。最隆重的纪录仍属于那笔为一名门将准备的交易——手续多达十九张表，传真机在第十四张时宣布退役，球员本人据称是通过电视得知自己转会的。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Fax-jam history is window history: one year an unsigned agreement, one year a restaurant menu filed as transfer documents, this year the classic missing second page. The record belongs to a goalkeeper's deal — nineteen forms, the fax retiring on the fourteenth, the player learning of his transfer on television.
pages.bodyRight: 电子化改革年年提上日程，年年败给仪式感。扫描件照样要打印出来签字，再扫描回去——纸张被淘汰了，纸的鬼魂还在流程里上班。本刊预测：明年此时，会有俱乐部宣布启用全新数字系统，然后在截止夜十一点半重启传真机。
pages.bodyRightEn: Digital reform is tabled yearly, and yearly loses to ceremony. Scans get printed, signed, scanned back — paper is dead; its ghost still works the process. Prediction: next year a club unveils an all-new digital system, then reboots the fax at 11:30pm on deadline night.
pages.pullQuote: “技术会进步，卡纸会找到新的形式。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Technology advances; the jam finds new forms.”
pages.sidebarBody: 纸盒太满、文件太急、经纪人在电话里喊“马上到”。三者同时出现，请换一台。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Tray too full, documents too urgent, an agent shouting 'nearly there'. All three: change machines.

pages.headline: “我们完成了主要目标”：关窗声明对照翻译
pages.headlineEn: 'We Completed Our Main Objectives': Window Statements, Translated
pages.deck: 官方话术与实际操作的参考译文。
pages.deckEn: Official phrasing, with reference translations.
pages.bodyLeft: 关窗声明对照翻译，本年度修订版：“我们完成了主要目标”——没买到首选；“现有阵容具备竞争力”——预算已锁；“俱乐部着眼青训”——预算锁得比较彻底；“这是一次战略性沉默”——传真机真的坏了。声明越短，事情越大，这是冬窗的摩尔定律。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Closing statements, a parallel translation, revised edition: 'We completed our main objectives' — missed the first choice. 'The squad is competitive' — budget locked. 'Focused on youth development' — budget very locked. 'A strategic silence' — the fax really broke. The shorter the statement, the bigger the story: the window's Moore's law.
pages.bodyRight: 卖方的修辞同样精彩：“尊重球员意愿”通常意味着球员已经租好了新公寓；“双赢”意味着双方都亏得不好意思声张。而所有宣布新援“数据出色”的通稿，其统计口径与赛季初著名的“四十一球”疑似出自同一家出版社。本刊已致函求证，回信是一张空白的第二页。
pages.bodyRightEn: Sellers' rhetoric too: 'respecting the player's wishes' usually means he's already rented the new flat; 'win-win' means both lost too much to admit. Every release hailing 'outstanding numbers' seems to share a publisher with the famous '41 goals'. We wrote to enquire; the reply was a blank second page.
pages.pullQuote: “每份关窗声明都应附一份诚实度附录。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Every closing statement should ship with an honesty annex.”
pages.sidebarBody: “符合长期规划”“时机不合适”“尊重球员意愿”——详见附录，附录不存在。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: 'Long-term plan', 'timing wasn't right', 'respecting the player's wishes' — see annex. No annex exists.

pages.headline: 冬窗成绩单的评分方法：三月以前不给分
pages.headlineEn: Grading the Window: No Marks Before March
pages.deck: 现在打分的都是票务部门。
pages.deckEn: Anyone grading now works in ticketing.
pages.bodyLeft: 现在就能评分的事项：注册是否完成、文件是否齐全、体检是否真实通过、球衣号码是否已分配且无遮挡物。这些都属于行政分，虽然无聊，但历史上确有交易死在一张表上——具体是第十九张。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Gradeable now: registration done, documents complete, medical genuinely passed, shirt number allocated and unobstructed. Administrative marks — boring, but deals have died on a single form. The nineteenth, precisely.
pages.bodyRight: 现在不能评分的：融入、化学反应、状态曲线，以及一切带“双赢”字样的结论。新援的第一次触球和第五十次触球之间隔着整个春天。三月看出场，四月看贡献，五月看积分榜——一月公布的评分只代表心情。
pages.bodyRightEn: Not gradeable: settling, chemistry, form curves, anything containing 'win-win'. Between a signing's first touch and his fiftieth lies a whole spring. March for minutes, April for contribution, May for the table — January grades measure mood.
pages.pullQuote: “冬窗评分在五月公布，一月公布的叫心情。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Window grades are published in May; January's are called mood.”
pages.sidebarBody: 三月看出场，四月看贡献，五月看积分榜。一月只看传真机维修单。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: March: minutes. April: contribution. May: the table. January: fax repair bills only.

mag.season.33.issueTitle: 淘汰赛特辑：由守转攻三秒钟
mag.season.33.issueTitleEn: Knockout Special: Three Seconds to Attack

pages.headline: 由守转攻的三秒钟，淘汰赛的全部存款
pages.headlineEn: Three Seconds From Defence to Attack: The Knockouts' Entire Savings
pages.deck: 夺回球权之后，账单立即到期。
pages.deckEn: Once the ball is won back, the bill falls due.
pages.bodyLeft: 淘汰赛的第一课只有三秒：夺回球权后的三秒里，向前还是横传，是整场比赛最真实的自我介绍。联赛可以掩饰，两回合制会把答案复印两遍。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Lesson one of the knockouts lasts three seconds: forward or sideways after the regain is a match's most honest self-introduction. A league season disguises it; two legs photocopy the answer twice.
pages.bodyRight: 本刊观察了十六次快速反击，成功的都具备同一件事：有人在丢球前就已经开始跑位。反击不是从抢下球开始，是从预感开始。
pages.bodyRightEn: We watched sixteen fast breaks; the successful ones all had someone running before the ball was even lost. A counter begins not with the tackle but with anticipation.
pages.pullQuote: “三秒钟不够思考人生，但足够看清一支球队。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Three seconds won't rethink your life, but will show you a team.”
pages.sidebarBody: 第一脚向前、最近队友的启动方向、丢球方阵型尚未回头。三者齐了就快跑。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: First pass forward; nearest teammate's start; their shape not yet turned. All three: run.

pages.headline: 反击不是速度，是提前量
pages.headlineEn: A Counter Is Not Speed — It's a Head Start
pages.deck: 跑得快的球队很多，提前开始的很少。
pages.deckEn: Many teams run fast; few start early.
pages.bodyLeft: 解剖一次成功的反击，你会发现它开始得比录像显示的更早：第一脚传球之前，弱侧已经有人启动，第三人已经在跑传球者的传球线路。小组赛阶段我们写过某位边锋的警告——给他十米空间，你最好直接犯规。淘汰赛的问题是：经验老到的球队根本不会给你那十米。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Dissect a good counter: it began before the tape shows. Before the first pass, someone is moving on the far side, a third man already running the passer's lane. In the groups we warned about a certain winger — give him ten yards, just foul. The knockout problem: experienced teams never give you the ten.
pages.bodyRight: 三秒规则可以训练：夺回球权后第一脚向前、最近两人立即交叉、丢球方五秒内反抢。但体能账必须另算——赛季初那辆“时速两百公里的坦克”提醒我们，坦克也需要加油时间表。反击的质量，一半在脚法，一半在保养记录。
pages.bodyRightEn: The rule is trainable: first pass forward, nearest two interchange, five-second counter-press. But fuel is billed separately — early season's '200 km/h tank' reminds us even tanks need refuelling schedules. A counter's quality is half technique, half maintenance records.
pages.pullQuote: “最快的反击，在对方射门之前就开始了。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The fastest counter begins before the opponent's shot.”
pages.sidebarBody: 三秒内出球演练；丢球后五人围抢窗口；反击后的回防路线同样计时。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Three-second release drills; counter-press window; recovery runs timed too.

pages.headline: 两回合制：第一回合是问卷，第二回合是口供
pages.headlineEn: Two Legs: First a Questionnaire, Then a Confession
pages.deck: 一百八十分钟里，谎言会被回放。
pages.deckEn: Across 180 minutes, lies get replayed.
pages.bodyLeft: 两回合制是一面诚实的镜子：第一回合试探，第二回合摊牌，联赛里能藏住的东西在这里会被回放两遍。一个失误可以写进整年纪录片，一次成功的领先控制也可以——只是后者的观众少得多。教练组最常犯的错误，是在首回合就用完了所有惊喜。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Two legs are an honest mirror: leg one probes, leg two lays cards down; what a league season hides gets replayed twice. One mistake can fill a year-long documentary — so can one expertly managed lead, only with fewer viewers. The classic coaching error: spending every surprise in leg one.
pages.bodyRight: 客场策略的真相很朴素：前二十分钟不丢球，比进一个球更改变系列赛的走向。领先的球队练习的不是进攻，是把对手的急躁养大。本刊提示：别把悬念当敌人，悬念是第二回合的门票收入。至于想一口气解决悬念的球队，历史上他们多半在第二回合成了悬念本身。
pages.bodyRightEn: Away strategy's truth is plain: not conceding in the first twenty minutes changes a tie more than scoring. Leaders don't practise attack; they farm the opponent's impatience. Suspense isn't the enemy — it's leg two's gate receipts. Teams who try to settle it in one go have mostly become the suspense themselves.
pages.pullQuote: “淘汰赛不淘汰运气，只淘汰没有预案的人。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Knockouts don't eliminate luck, only the unprepared.”
pages.sidebarBody: 别把悬念当敌人；别为集锦踢客场；换人名额留给加时赛的可能。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Suspense isn't the enemy; don't play away legs for the reel; save a sub for extra time.

pages.headline: 淘汰赛球探清单：只看进球的人别带去客场
pages.headlineEn: Knockout Scouting: Leave the Goal-Watchers at Home
pages.deck: 高压样本的采集与误读。
pages.deckEn: Collecting — and misreading — pressure samples.
pages.bodyLeft: 淘汰赛要看的不是集锦动作，是压力反应：丢球后五秒的决策、被扳平后开球那一分钟、客场前二十分钟的出球选择、定位球防守时谁在指挥。这些片段在两回合里会重复出现，样本虽小，浓度很高。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Watch pressure, not highlights: decisions five seconds after losing it, the restart minute after an equaliser, early distribution away, who commands at set-pieces. These repeat across two legs — small sample, high concentration.
pages.bodyRight: 误读区同样标注清楚：单场神勇不等于淘汰赛体质，对手少一人之后的数据要打折，点球大战录像评估不了技术，只能评估心率。至少看两场客场、一场落后状态；领先时的行为请单独标记——那是另一种人格。
pages.bodyRightEn: Misreading zone: one heroic game ≠ a knockout constitution; ten-men data gets discounted; shootout tape measures heart rate, not technique. Take two away games and one from behind; behaviour while leading gets its own tag — another personality.
pages.pullQuote: “淘汰赛的录像要看到第八十九分钟，包括替补席。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Watch knockout tape to the 89th minute, bench included.”
pages.sidebarBody: 至少两场客场；至少一场落后状态；比分领先时的行为单独标记。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Two away games; one trailing state; leading behaviour tagged separately.

mag.season.36.issueTitle: 盲侧特刊：看不见的地方决定比分
mag.season.36.issueTitleEn: Blind-Side Issue: The Unseen Decides the Score

pages.headline: 盲侧跑动：进球发生在镜头外的那一侧
pages.headlineEn: Blind-Side Runs: Goals Happen Off-Camera
pages.deck: 防守者的肩膀后面，住着整个赛季的失球。
pages.deckEn: Behind defenders' shoulders lives a season of goals conceded.
pages.bodyLeft: 统计员数得清触球，数不清盲侧。一名前锋在边后卫肩后启动三次，两次没有接到球，第三次上了第二天的集锦——前两次才是球探该看的部分。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Statisticians count touches, not blind sides. A striker starts three runs off the full-back's shoulder; two go unrewarded, the third makes the highlights. The first two are the scout's job.
pages.bodyRight: 本刊提醒：集锦镜头的宽度是剪辑师决定的，球场的宽度不是。看不见的地方决定比分，也决定报价。
pages.bodyRightEn: Reminder: a highlight clip's width is set by the editor; a pitch's width is not. The unseen decides the score — and the bid.
pages.pullQuote: “防守者回头的那一刻，进攻已经发生了一秒。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “When the defender turns his head, the attack is a second old.”
pages.sidebarBody: 启动在肩后、路线绕盲区、传球来自弱侧。集锦里通常只有最后一项有画面。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Start on the shoulder; bend through the blind spot; receive from the far side. Reels show only the last.

pages.headline: 盲区物理学：肩膀、视线与半秒的租金
pages.headlineEn: Blind-Spot Physics: Shoulders, Sightlines, Half-Second Leases
pages.deck: 如何用别人的脖子赢得空间。
pages.deckEn: How to win space using someone else's neck.
pages.bodyLeft: 盲侧的物理学基础是人类的脖子：防守者回头看球的瞬间，肩膀后面会开出一块免费空间，租期半秒。优秀的前锋不住在越位线上，住在那块空间里。冬窗我们写过一名喜欢从前锋身后钻进禁区的年轻人——他的整条路线，几乎全程不交“视线税”。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Blind-side physics rests on the human neck: the instant a defender checks the ball, free space opens behind his shoulder — half-second lease. Great forwards live there, not on the offside line. Recall this winter's youngster darting in from behind forwards — his whole route pays almost no sightline tax.
pages.bodyRight: 防守端的对应叫“盲区轮值”：中卫看球时边卫收肩，边卫被突破时后腰换位。失球回放里最常见的一句话是“我以为他在你那边”——盲侧失球从来不是一个人的失误，是两个人共同的客气。训练场上纠正它的办法也很朴素：要求每个人传球前先报出自己余光里有谁。
pages.bodyRightEn: The defensive answer is blind-side shift-work: centre-back watches ball, full-back tucks shoulder; full-back beaten, the pivot swaps. The most common line in any conceded-goal replay is 'I thought he was yours' — blind-side goals are never one man's error but two men's courtesy. The fix is plain: before passing, name who's in your peripheral vision.
pages.pullQuote: “最好的跑位，是让对方后卫怀疑自己的余光。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The best run makes a defender doubt his own peripheral vision.”
pages.sidebarBody: 启动时机、对传球者视线的利用、接球前最后两步的角度。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Start timing; use of the passer's sightline; angle of the last two steps.

pages.headline: 看录像时请盯着没有球的人
pages.headlineEn: Rewatching? Stare at the Man Without the Ball
pages.deck: 球探的遥控器应该停在画面边缘。
pages.deckEn: A scout's pause button belongs at the frame's edge.
pages.bodyLeft: 录像第二遍的正确看法是盯着没球的人：进球前二十秒，谁在牵制，谁在拉开宽度，谁的跑动让传球线路存在。集锦不会给你这些，因为镜头宽度是剪辑师决定的，球场宽度不是。有些真相在镜头外，就像有些球衣号码在三明治后面——你不能因为看不见，就当它不存在。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The correct second viewing stares at the ball-less: twenty seconds before a goal, who pins, who stretches, whose run creates the passing lane. Highlights won't show it — the editor sets the frame's width; the pitch doesn't. Some truths live off-camera, like some shirt numbers live behind sandwiches: unseen is not non-existent.
pages.bodyRight: 这也是现场看球仍然不可替代的原因：转播机位有盲区，球探的座位可以换。笔记模板很简单——每次无球牵制记一笔，每半场估算一次“为队友腾出的平方米”。数字是估的，趋势是真的，而趋势正是报价的依据。如果预算只够买一张票，请买能看见另一侧看台的座位。
pages.bodyRightEn: Which is why live attendance stays irreplaceable: broadcast angles have blind spots; a scout's seat can move. Note template: log every off-ball pin; once a half, estimate 'square metres freed for teammates'. Numbers are estimates, trends are real — and trends are what bids rest on. One ticket in the budget? Buy the seat facing the far side.
pages.pullQuote: “球在左边，比赛常常在右边。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Ball on the left, the match often on the right.”
pages.sidebarBody: 进球前二十秒的无球人；丢球时离球最远的人；庆祝时对方谁在系鞋带。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Ball-less men 20 seconds before goals; furthest man at turnovers; who ties laces during celebrations.

pages.headline: 盲侧评估表：给看不见的东西打分
pages.headlineEn: The Blind-Side Scorecard: Grading the Invisible
pages.deck: 无球价值的评分框架与常见误判。
pages.deckEn: A framework for off-ball value, and its classic errors.
pages.bodyLeft: 可评分项：牵制防守人数、拉开宽度的次数、为队友创造接球线的跑动、丢球后第一时间的回位路线。这些都不进集锦，但都可以进报告——前提是记录者愿意把视线从球上移开，并且坐到一个看得见整条弱侧的座位。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Gradeable: defenders pinned, width-stretching runs, runs creating a teammate's receiving lane, the recovery route after turnovers. None make highlights; all can make reports — if the recorder takes his eyes off the ball and sits where the whole far side is visible.
pages.bodyRight: 常见误判：把“没碰球”当“没参与”，把“拉开”当“散步”，把镜头外的贡献当成不存在。评估者自己也有盲区，承认这一点是方法的一部分。看不懂的无球跑动，先别打低分，先换座位。
pages.bodyRightEn: Classic errors: reading 'no touches' as 'not involved', 'stretching' as 'strolling'. Evaluators have blind spots too; admitting it is part of the method. If a run makes no sense, don't mark it down — change seats.
pages.pullQuote: “最好的牵制，是让数据表上多出一名不存在的队友。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The best pinning adds a non-existent teammate to the data sheet.”
pages.sidebarBody: 每次无球牵制记一笔；每半场统计“为队友腾出的平方米”。数字是估的，趋势是真的。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Log every off-ball pin; each half, tally 'square metres freed'. Numbers are estimates; trends are real.

mag.season.39.issueTitle: 紧缩生存号：一个人顶三个人
mag.season.39.issueTitleEn: Austerity Issue: One Man Does the Job of Three

pages.headline: 预算被剪角之后：一个人顶三个人使用手册
pages.headlineEn: After the Cuts: A Manual for One Man Doing Three Jobs
pages.deck: 紧缩财政不是战术，是算术。
pages.deckEn: Austerity is not a tactic; it's arithmetic.
pages.bodyLeft: 当体育主管的预算表出现剪角，多面手的行情就会上涨。能踢三个位置的人确实省钱——前提是你接受他在三个位置都领到同一份“还行”的评价。
pages.bodyLeftEn: When the budget sheet gets its corners clipped, the utility man's stock rises. A man who plays three positions saves money — if you accept 'serviceable' at all three.
pages.bodyRight: 本刊走访了三家紧缩俱乐部，共同点是：医疗室比更衣室空，祈祷室比分析室忙，以及每个人都声称认识“哪里缺人补哪里”先生的远房亲戚。
pages.bodyRightEn: We visited three austerity clubs. Shared traits: treatment room emptier than the dressing room, prayer room busier than the analysis room, and everyone knows a relative of Mr Plug-Any-Gap.
pages.pullQuote: “一个人顶三个人，首先他得顶得住自己那一份。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “To do three men's jobs, he must first hold down his own.”
pages.sidebarBody: 转会费预算为零；租借预算也为零；“内部挖潜”四个字出现在所有会议纪要里。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Transfer budget: zero. Loan budget: zero. 'Internal solutions' in every set of minutes.

pages.headline: 多面手的真实价格：一份工资，三份说明书
pages.headlineEn: The Utility Man's True Price: One Wage, Three Manuals
pages.deck: 全能与全不能之间，隔着一场正式比赛。
pages.deckEn: Between can-do-all and can-do-none lies one real match.
pages.bodyLeft: 多面手行情在紧缩周期必然上涨，评估方法也必须升级：每个位置单独评级，分开看录像。“都能踢”和“都踢过”是两回事，客串过三场边后卫不代表他能扛住整个四月。一份工资买三份说明书听起来划算，但说明书的厚度通常和质量成反比。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Utility prices rise in austerity cycles; upgrade the method: grade each position separately, watch separate tapes. 'Can play' ≠ 'has played' — three guest games at full-back don't survive an April. One wage for three manuals sounds cheap; a manual's thickness usually inverts its quality.
pages.bodyRight: 风险主要有二：多位置轮换会放大伤病，今天补左路明天补中路的人，肌肉也在不停换工作；其二是战术模糊成本——哪里缺人补哪里，最后可能哪里都不缺、哪里都不精。紧缩球队的正确用法是：给他两个固定位置，把第三个位置留给真正的紧急状态。
pages.bodyRightEn: Two main risks: rotation across positions amplifies injuries — the man patching left today, middle tomorrow, makes his muscles change jobs non-stop; and tactical blur — plug every gap, end up short of nothing and good at nothing. Correct usage: two fixed positions, the third for true emergencies only.
pages.pullQuote: “能补所有位置的人，最怕被安排补所有位置。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “He who can fill every position most fears being asked to.”
pages.sidebarBody: 每个位置至少一场完整录像；“客串过”不等于“能胜任”；门将除外，别问为什么。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: One full tape per position; 'has guested' ≠ 'can hold down'; keepers excepted — don't ask why.

pages.headline: 免费的东西按时间收费
pages.headlineEn: Free Things Charge by the Hour
pages.deck: 自由身、租借与青训的隐形账单。
pages.deckEn: The hidden invoices of frees, loans and academies.
pages.bodyLeft: 紧缩工具箱就三样：自由身、租借、青训。自由身的成本在工资单，租借的成本在分摊条款，青训的成本在时间——而时间恰恰是积分榜不肯赊账的货币。便宜选项里也有踏实货：某些老将的全部装备只有一双旧鞋和一只保温杯，但落点判断这种东西，从来不需要预算审批。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The austerity toolbox holds three items: frees, loans, academy. A free's cost sits in wages, a loan's in share clauses, an academy's in time — the one currency the table won't lend. Solid goods exist among the cheap: some veterans' whole kit is old boots and a thermos, but judging a ball's drop never needed budget approval.
pages.bodyRight: 卖人心理学是另一半学问：别在所有人都知道你缺钱的时候挂牌，那等于给报价单打七折再发出去。主席热线在紧缩期尤其危险，深夜的一句“要不我们再看看那个谁”，第二天就会变成会议纪要。紧缩俱乐部的第一条纪律：穷要穷得有保密意识。
pages.bodyRightEn: Selling psychology is the other half: don't list players when all know you're skint — that's a 30% discount pre-applied to every bid. The chairman's hotline is most dangerous now; a late-night 'what about what's-his-name' becomes minutes by morning. Rule one of austerity: be poor with confidentiality.
pages.pullQuote: “穷不是问题，让对手知道你穷才是。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Poor isn't the problem; them knowing you're poor is.”
pages.sidebarBody: 压价到最后一周；省掉体检；让主教练兼职司机——第三项已有俱乐部试行，结果不予刊登。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Haggling into the last week; skipping medicals; coach doubling as driver — trialled once; results withheld.

pages.headline: 紧缩球探报告模板：把钱花在问题上
pages.headlineEn: The Austerity Report Template: Spend on Questions
pages.deck: 预算越少，报告越要短而准。
pages.deckEn: The smaller the budget, the shorter the report.
pages.bodyLeft: 预算越少，报告越短，问题越要准：能不能立刻首发？伤病史如何？工资要求多少？是否适配某一个明确职责？四个问题答完，一页纸就够了。紧缩时代的豪华报告是一种浪费，把钱花在问题上，不是花在形容词上。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Smaller budget, shorter report, sharper questions: can he start now? Injury history? Wage demand? Does he fit one defined role? Four answers, one page. Luxury reports are waste in austere times — spend on questions, not adjectives.
pages.bodyRight: 可删除内容清单：潜力形容词、五年规划、社交媒体粉丝数。本赛季某位四百万粉丝的候选人已经证明：粉丝不会分摊工资，也不会在客场回追。报告超出一页，说明你还没决定到底要问什么。
pages.bodyRightEn: Deletable: potential adjectives, five-year plans, follower counts. One four-million-follower candidate proved it this season: followers don't split wages or track back away. Past one page means you haven't decided what you're asking.
pages.pullQuote: “预算紧张时，每一行废话都是支出。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Tight budgets make every line of waffle an expense.”
pages.sidebarBody: 报告超出一页，说明你还没决定要问什么；超过三页，说明你在写回忆录。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Past one page: you haven't decided the question. Past three: you're writing a memoir.

mag.season.42.issueTitle: 冲刺特辑：积分榜拒绝礼貌
mag.season.42.issueTitleEn: Run-In Special: The Table Stops Being Polite

pages.headline: 冲刺阶段：积分榜开始拒绝礼貌
pages.headlineEn: The Run-In: The Table Stops Being Polite
pages.deck: 四月以后，每一分都要出示证件。
pages.deckEn: After April, every point must show ID.
pages.bodyLeft: 联赛进入冲刺，积分榜撤掉了礼貌模式：净胜球不再微笑，相互战绩开始翻旧账，“理论上还有机会”的队伍排到了街角。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The table switches off polite mode: goal difference stops smiling, head-to-heads dig up old scores, and the 'mathematically alive' queue round the corner.
pages.bodyRight: 引援窗口早已关闭，于是所有问题都被翻译成同一句话：你现在的这些人，还能拿出什么没拿出来过的东西？
pages.bodyRightEn: The window closed long ago, so every question becomes: what can your current lot produce that they haven't yet?
pages.pullQuote: “积分榜不记仇，它只是记性很好。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The table holds no grudges; it just remembers well.”
pages.sidebarBody: 赛程表被圈红；办公室积分计算器常开；人人都说“只看下一场”，没人信。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Fixtures circled red; points calculator always open; everyone says 'one game at a time'; nobody believes it.

pages.headline: 四月体能学：油箱见底时谁在说谎
pages.headlineEn: April Physiology: Who Lies When the Tank Runs Dry
pages.deck: 疲劳首先攻击的不是腿，是决策。
pages.deckEn: Fatigue attacks decisions first, not legs.
pages.bodyLeft: 四月的疲劳首先攻击的不是腿，是决策：传球选择变直，回追少半步，赛前喊着加练的人突然准时下班。赛季初我们围观过“时速两百公里的坦克”和永动机式的人物，现在到了检查保养记录的时候——神话也要做四月年检，而且年检不过不许上路。
pages.bodyLeftEn: April fatigue attacks decisions before legs: passes go direct, recovery runs fall half a step short, the extra-training advocate suddenly clocks off on time. We watched early season's '200 km/h tank' and the perpetual-motion man; now check the maintenance records — myths need an April MOT, and no pass means no road.
pages.bodyRight: 体能管理的正面教材都藏在细节里：轮换发生在疲劳之前而不是之后，老将有专属的恢复日程。有些保温杯里泡着的配方属于球队一级机密，本刊不打听成分，只确认效果——四月的赛场上，温度也是一种竞争力。疲劳可以原谅，对疲劳撒谎不行。
pages.bodyRightEn: Model fitness management hides in details: rotation before fatigue, not after; bespoke veteran recovery schedules. Some thermos flasks hold club-classified recipes — we don't ask ingredients, only confirm results: in April, temperature is a competitive edge. Fatigue can be forgiven; lying about it cannot.
pages.pullQuote: “跑得动是体能，知道什么时候跑是体能管理。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Being able to run is fitness; knowing when is fitness management.”
pages.sidebarBody: 回追少半步；传球选择变直；训练后加练的人突然不加练了。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Recovery runs half a step short; passes gone direct; the extra-training man stops.

pages.headline: 争冠与保级：同一种失眠，两种药方
pages.headlineEn: Title and Relegation: One Insomnia, Two Prescriptions
pages.deck: 压力在榜首和榜尾长得一模一样。
pages.deckEn: Pressure looks identical at top and bottom.
pages.bodyLeft: 冲刺期的心理结构很对称：榜首怕失去，榜尾怕希望，中间怕无聊。压力在显微镜下长得一模一样，区别只在于积分榜的方向。教练发布会进入高频模式，“一场一场踢”的使用率与他的排名焦虑呈正相关，而与球队的实际赛程密度毫无关系。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Run-in psychology is symmetrical: the top fears losing it, the bottom fears hope, the middle fears boredom. Under the microscope pressure is identical; only the table's direction differs. Pressers go high-frequency; 'one game at a time' usage correlates with table anxiety, not fixture congestion.
pages.bodyRight: 这个时节最考验阵容里的特殊物种：比如那位十次过人九次失败的赌徒型前锋。常规赛里九次失败是噪音，四月以后教练们私下承认——如果那一次成功发生在第 89 分钟，前面九次都可以当场追封为战术铺垫。冲刺期不奖励谨慎，只奖励准备好了的大胆。
pages.bodyRightEn: This season tests special species — say, the gambler whose nine dribbles out of ten fail. In the regular season the nine are noise; after April, managers admit privately: if the one lands in the 89th minute, the nine are posthumously reclassified as build-up. The run-in rewards not caution but prepared boldness.
pages.pullQuote: “榜首和榜尾的区别，只是望远镜的方向。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Top and bottom differ only in which way the telescope points.”
pages.sidebarBody: “压力在对手那边”=压力在我们这边；“足球什么都可能发生”=我们落后。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: 'The pressure is on them' = it's on us; 'anything can happen' = we're behind.

pages.headline: 冲刺期评估：谁在四月还是四月前的球员
pages.headlineEn: Run-In Evaluation: Who Is Still Themselves in April
pages.deck: 赛季样本终于够大，借口终于不够用了。
pages.deckEn: The sample is finally big enough; the excuses aren't.
pages.bodyLeft: 到了四月，样本终于够大：全季录像、强强对话、客场表现、连续三周的稳定性，都可以交叉验证。现在写进档案的报告，夏天可以直接调档，不必再从“据说”开始。四月的录像是有利息的，一月再取。
pages.bodyLeftEn: By April the sample is big enough: full-season tape, strong-side matches, away form, three-week consistency — all cross-checkable. Reports filed now pull straight from the archive come summer. April footage earns interest; withdraw in January.
pages.bodyRight: 干扰项也到了高发期：合同年爆发、无欲无求对手的礼貌性防守、垃圾时间刷出的数据。另请注意冲刺期报价的情绪溢价——争冠队买急，保级队买慌，价格里三成是心跳。现在标记，夏天复核。
pages.bodyRightEn: Noise peaks too: contract-year surges, courtesy defending, garbage-time stats. And the emotional premium on run-in bids — chasers buy urgency, strugglers buy panic; 30% of the price is heartbeat. Tag now, re-check in summer.
pages.pullQuote: “四月的录像有利息，一月再取。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “April footage earns interest; withdraw in January.”
pages.sidebarBody: 现在标记，夏天复核；别在冲刺期报价，情绪溢价高达三成。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Tag now, re-check in summer; never bid in the run-in — 30% is heartbeat.

mag.season.45.issueTitle: 半决赛号：替补席深度检查

pages.headline: 半决赛周：请检查替补席的保质期
pages.headlineEn: Semi-Final Week: Check the Bench's Expiry Date
pages.deck: 首发的故事写到五月，结局常常由第 14 人决定。
pages.deckEn: The starters' story runs to May; the ending often belongs to man No. 14.
pages.bodyLeft: 半决赛周的传统节目：记者数首发，教练数替补，队医数恢复天数。三张清单里，只有第二张没有对外公布。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Semi-final week's ritual: journalists count starters, coaches count subs, physios count recovery days. Only the second list stays unpublished.
pages.bodyRight: 两回合打到这一步，首发十一人已经被对手研究到可以背诵。真正的变量坐在替补席上，披着训练背心，假装没有在热身。
pages.bodyRightEn: By now the starting eleven has been studied until opponents can recite it. The real variables sit on the bench, bibbed, pretending not to warm up.
pages.pullQuote: “替补席的深度，是主力受伤那天才知道的水位。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Bench depth is a water level learned the day a starter gets hurt.”
pages.sidebarBody: 第 12 至 18 人的出场状态；位置覆盖；最近一场比赛日期是否还属于本赛季。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Readiness of men 12–18; positional cover; whether their last match date is still this season.

pages.headline: 第 12 人经济学：坐板凳也要保持室温
pages.headlineEn: The Economics of Man No. 12: Keep the Bench at Room Temperature
pages.deck: 替补的价值在准备，不在等待。
pages.deckEn: A sub's value lies in preparation, not waiting.
pages.bodyLeft: 替补管理的全部难点在于：让不比赛的人保持比赛状态。内部对抗赛的强度、个人计划的针对性、登场前那套固定热身流程，都是保鲜技术。历史上随队夺冠却长期坐板凳的门将们证明了另一件事——奖杯上也有替补的指纹，只是印在握手的那一面。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Bench management's whole difficulty: keeping non-players match-ready. In-house game intensity, targeted individual plans, the fixed pre-entry warm-up — all preservation technology. Long-benched keepers with winners' medals proved one more thing: trophies carry subs' fingerprints too, just on the handshaking side.
pages.bodyRight: 半决赛换人是一场提前开始的棋局：换人名额对应不同时段，六十分钟的对位牌、七十五分钟的体能牌、加时前的心跳牌。点球预案更要提前写好顺序——十二码决胜不是抽签环节，是家庭作业的检查环节。临场才翻作业本的人，通常也找不到本子。
pages.bodyRightEn: Semi-final subs are chess started early: slots map to phases — the match-up card at 60 minutes, the legs card at 75, the heartbeat card before extra time. Write the penalty order in advance: twelve yards is homework inspection, not a lottery. Those who hunt for the workbook on the night usually can't find it.
pages.pullQuote: “好替补不是耐心的人，是随时不耐烦但准备好了的人。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A good sub isn't patient — he's permanently impatient and prepared.”
pages.sidebarBody: 内部对抗赛强度；个人训练计划；家属票别订在决赛前一周——注意力也是库存。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: In-house intensity; individual plans; no family tickets for final week — attention is inventory too.

pages.headline: 评估替补：把“没上场”翻译成“准备得怎样”
pages.headlineEn: Assessing Subs: Translate 'Didn't Play' Into 'How Prepared'
pages.deck: 零分钟出场不等于零信息。
pages.deckEn: Zero minutes is not zero information.
pages.bodyLeft: “没上场”可以翻译出很多信息：训练录像里的投入度、热身是否永远第一个开始、替补登场后的前五分钟处理球、以及被换下队友走回来时他的表情。板凳长度可以用尺子量，板凳温度要伸手试。
pages.bodyLeftEn: 'Didn't play' translates richly: training-ground engagement, always first to warm up, his first five minutes after coming on, his face as the subbed teammate returns. Bench length is measured with a ruler; bench temperature is felt by hand.
pages.bodyRight: 陷阱一侧：久疏战阵的比赛节奏无法靠训练模拟，友谊赛强度是幻觉，“训练型球员”是真实存在的物种。评估替补请用多渠道：青年队比赛、队内对抗统计、以及训练场边线——那里比新闻发布会诚实。
pages.bodyRightEn: Traps: lost match rhythm can't be simulated, friendly intensity is illusion, and the 'training-ground player' is a real species. Assess via youth games, in-house stats, and the training touchline — more honest than press conferences.
pages.pullQuote: “板凳长度可以量，板凳温度要伸手。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Bench length can be measured; bench temperature must be felt.”
pages.sidebarBody: 训练场边线比新闻发布会诚实；青年队比赛录像；队内对抗的技术统计。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: The training touchline beats press conferences; youth footage; in-house stats.

pages.headline: 半决赛可能十二码决胜：请先核对扑救史
pages.headlineEn: It Could Go to Twelve Yards: Audit the Saving History
pages.deck: 点球档案、病假记录与第五个主罚者。
pages.deckEn: Penalty archives, sick notes, and the fifth taker.
pages.bodyLeft: 半决赛周的点球档案室总会热闹起来：扑救方向统计、主罚习惯、助跑节奏。整理时请把传说归入文学档案——那个“一个下午扑出五粒点球”的经典案例，官方记录是四次，第五位主罚者在助跑前请了病假。档案标签建议写：好听，不可用于战术会议。
pages.bodyLeftEn: In semi-final week the penalty archive gets busy: save-direction stats, taker habits, run-up rhythms. File legend under literature — the classic 'five saves in one afternoon' officially records four; the fifth taker called in sick before his run-up. Suggested label: lovely story, unfit for tactical meetings.
pages.bodyRight: 严肃部分：训练点球的命中率与正式点球是两个物种，中间隔着心跳和看台的噪音。门将研究的是趋势，不是读心术；主罚者准备的是预案，不是勇气。家庭作业做到位的人，掷硬币时也会显得比较幸运。档案室里还有一句批注：统计口径不清的扑救史，一律按病假处理。
pages.bodyRightEn: Serious part: training penalties and real ones are two species separated by heartbeat and crowd noise. Keepers study trends, not minds; takers prepare plans, not courage. Homework done looks luckier at the coin toss. Archive note: saving histories with unclear methodology are processed as sick notes.
pages.pullQuote: “点球大战是掷硬币，但有人把硬币练出了汗。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A shootout is a coin toss — but some have trained the coin to sweat.”
pages.sidebarBody: 可查：扑救方向统计。不可查：“他从小就扑点”。存疑：任何带“传说”二字的材料。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Verifiable: save-direction stats. Unverifiable: 'saved pens since boyhood'. Doubtful: anything with 'legend'.

mag.season.48.issueTitle: 决赛月特辑：冷静、奇迹与新球衣
mag.season.48.issueTitleEn: Final-Month Special: Calm, Miracles, New Kits

pages.headline: 决赛月：谈冷静的与谈奇迹的在同一张积分榜上
pages.headlineEn: Final Month: The Calm and the Miraculous Share One Table
pages.deck: 还有人已经开始卖下赛季的球衣。
pages.deckEn: And someone is already selling next season's kit.
pages.bodyLeft: 决赛月的三种声音：争冠队谈冷静，保级队谈奇迹，中游队发布了下赛季球衣——预售页面的加载速度比球队反击还快。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Three voices: chasers preach calm, strugglers preach miracles, mid-table clubs launch next season's kit — the pre-order page loads faster than their counters.
pages.bodyRight: 本刊不评价哪种声音更体面。我们只提醒：冷静需要体能存款，奇迹需要概率许可证，球衣需要有人还在买。
pages.bodyRightEn: We judge no voice's dignity. Note only: calm needs fitness savings, miracles need probability permits, kits need buyers.
pages.pullQuote: “赛季最后一个月，人人成了哲学家，只有球衣商店是实干家。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “In the last month, everyone turns philosopher; only the club shop is a pragmatist.”
pages.sidebarBody: 冷静=领先；奇迹=落后；新球衣=既没领先也没落后，只剩库存。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Calm = ahead; miracle = behind; new kit = neither — just stock.

pages.headline: 决赛周的冷静是一种后勤工作
pages.headlineEn: Final-Week Calm Is a Logistics Job
pages.deck: 心态不是喊出来的，是日程表排出来的。
pages.deckEn: Composure isn't shouted into being; it's scheduled.
pages.bodyLeft: 决赛周的冷静不是心态课程，是后勤工程：睡眠统一、媒体隔离、训练节奏不临时加戏、家属门票安排在不碍事的看台。把激动列入日程表，排在决赛之后——这是所有冠军队的共同经验，虽然发布会上的说法永远是“平常心”。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Final-week calm isn't a mindset course but logistics: synchronised sleep, media quarantine, no training twists, family tickets seated harmlessly. Schedule excitement for after the final — every champion's shared habit, though pressers always say 'just another game'.
pages.bodyRight: 反面教材的清单每年都一样：决赛前接受四十分钟个人专访、官宣续约谈判、发布个人品牌联名。三件事都可以做，也都可以等。决赛周的优先级排序能力是冠军的隐形技能点——球衣商店除外，他们选择本周上新，并且从不需要体能教练签字。
pages.bodyRightEn: The cautionary list never changes: a forty-minute solo interview pre-final, announced contract talks, a personal-brand collab. All three are allowed; all three can wait. Prioritising in final week is a champion's hidden skill — the club shop excepted: they launch this week and never need a fitness coach's signature.
pages.pullQuote: “冷静是一种排程：把激动留给赛后发布会。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Calm is scheduling: save excitement for the post-match presser.”
pages.sidebarBody: 专访婉拒；社媒托管；合同谈判冻结；“梦幻赛季”四个字禁止使用。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Decline interviews; outsource socials; freeze contract talks; 'dream season' is banned.

pages.headline: 奇迹的申报流程与概率许可证
pages.headlineEn: The Miracle Application Process and Probability Permits
pages.deck: 落后一方也有战术：把所有可能摊在桌上。
pages.deckEn: The trailing side has tactics too: every possibility on the table.
pages.bodyLeft: 奇迹的申报流程其实有固定格式：一个早进球计划、库存里的定位球、一张留到最后的换人牌，以及利用对方“怕输”多过自己“想赢”的心理差。落后一方的战术不叫信仰，叫把所有可能性提前摊在桌上，再按概率从高到低排好队。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The miracle application has a fixed format: an early-goal plan, stocked set-pieces, one substitution card saved for last, and exploiting their fear of losing over your will to win. The trailing side's tactics aren't faith; they're every possibility laid out in advance, queued by probability.
pages.bodyRight: 赛后复盘总是拆奇迹的台：几乎每场经典逆转都能找出三个以上可解释因素。这也是赌徒型前锋在决赛月被重新估值的原因——九次失败是常规赛的统计噪音，一次成功就是决赛的全部内容。奇迹不接待没有准备的人，抽签也一样。
pages.bodyRightEn: Analysis always undercuts miracles: every famous comeback yields three-plus explainable factors. Hence the gambler's final-month repricing — nine failures are regular-season noise, one success is a final's whole content. Miracles admit no unprepared; neither do coin tosses.
pages.pullQuote: “奇迹不接待没有准备的人，抽签也一样。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Miracles admit no unprepared — neither do coin tosses.”
pages.sidebarBody: 一个早进球；一张未出的换人牌；一位忘了自己该紧张的年轻人。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: One early goal; one unused sub card; one youngster who forgot to be nervous.

pages.headline: 决赛观察席：一场比赛能证明什么
pages.headlineEn: Scouting the Final: What Can One Match Prove?
pages.deck: 决赛样本的加权重与减权重。
pages.deckEn: Weighting the final sample up — and down.
pages.bodyLeft: 决赛样本需要加权重看：抗压下的第一次触球、失误后的下一分钟、加时赛里谁还在主动要球。这些时刻把平时的技术统计煮开，浮上来的才是能带去下一季的东西。看台观察同样有效：决赛里的无球跑动比平时诚实。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Upweight a final's sample: first touch under pressure, the minute after a mistake, who still wants the ball in extra time. These boil the season's stats down; what floats carries into next season. Off-ball runs are more honest in finals too.
pages.bodyRight: 需要减权重看的：单场英雄主义的报价冲动、情绪化赛后采访里的承诺、以及“决赛级球员”标签的通货膨胀。决赛表现可以进档案，但不许独占档案；奖杯合影是纪念品，不是续约理由。
pages.bodyRightEn: Downweight: one-game heroism bids, emotional post-match promises, 'finals player' label inflation. A final performance enters the file but may not own it; the trophy photo is a souvenir, not a renewal case.
pages.pullQuote: “决赛能放大真相，也能放大滤镜。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “A final magnifies truth; it also magnifies filters.”
pages.sidebarBody: 决赛表现进档案，但不许独占档案；奖杯合影不代表续约理由。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Finals enter the file but may not own it; trophy photos aren't renewal cases.

mag.season.49.issueTitle: 决赛周专号：门将心理学

pages.headline: 决赛周的门将：一个人类与八百种内心戏
pages.headlineEn: The Final-Week Keeper: One Human, 800 Inner Monologues
pages.deck: 球门七米三二，思绪没有边线。
pages.deckEn: The goal is 7.32 metres; the thoughts have no touchline.
pages.bodyLeft: 决赛周的门将是最孤独的职业：全队围成一圈时，他在圈里；球在对方半场时，他在自己的回放里。心理学家说这叫岗位特性，门将说这叫周二。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The final-week keeper is the loneliest job: in the huddle yet alone; ball up the other end, he's in his own replays. Psychologists call it an occupational trait; keepers call it Tuesday.
pages.bodyRight: 本刊采访了三位参加过决赛的门将教练，结论一致：决赛前最好的心理建设，是让门将相信流程比结果大。其次才是祈祷。
pages.bodyRightEn: Three keeper coaches with final experience, one verdict: the best prep is convincing the keeper process outranks outcome. Prayer comes second.
pages.pullQuote: “九十分钟里门将只犯一次错就够写进年鉴——所以他们学会了先原谅自己。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “One mistake in 90 minutes makes the yearbook — so keepers learn to forgive themselves first.”
pages.sidebarBody: 睡眠优先；不看失误集锦；不与点球手对视超过三秒；手套多备一副。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Sleep first; no error reels; no eye contact with takers past three seconds; spare gloves packed.

pages.headline: 点球心理学：助跑、眼神与病假条
pages.headlineEn: Penalty Psychology: Run-Ups, Eye Contact, Sick Notes
pages.deck: 门将读人，主罚者读门将，心理学家读秒。
pages.deckEn: Keeper reads man, taker reads keeper, psychologist reads seconds.
pages.bodyLeft: 点球是一场双向的阅读：门将读助跑节奏和支撑脚，主罚者读门将的站位暗示，心理学家在场边读秒。经典教学案例仍在流传：某门将号称一下午五连扑，第五位主罚者因“突发不适”未能出场——心理战的最高境界，是让对手在助跑之前就医。
pages.bodyLeftEn: A penalty is two-way reading: keeper reads run-up and plant foot, taker reads the keeper's stance, psychologists read the seconds. Recall the classic: five claimed saves in one afternoon, the fifth taker withdrawing with 'sudden discomfort'. Mind games' summit: send your opponent to the doctor before his run-up.
pages.bodyRight: 门将一侧的正经准备包括：方向趋势卡、延迟启动的耐心、以及扑错方向后的情绪复位。点球大战里最大的敌人不是上一个进球的人，是上一个自己没扑到的球。资料可以打印，镇定只能预装，而且预装环境通常在赛前一周的每一个普通周二。
pages.bodyRightEn: The keeper's real prep: direction-trend cards, patience of the delayed dive, emotional reset after guessing wrong. In a shootout the biggest enemy isn't the last scorer but the last ball you didn't reach. Data can be printed; composure only pre-installed — on every ordinary Tuesday of the week before.
pages.pullQuote: “扑点不是靠猜，是靠让对方以为自己被猜中了。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Saving pens isn't guessing right — it's making them think you did.”
pages.sidebarBody: 助跑节奏变化、支撑脚方向、眼神停留。以及：留意谁突然系起了鞋带。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Run-up rhythm, plant foot, where eyes linger — and who suddenly ties his laces.

pages.headline: 决赛门将评估：把心跳也算进技术统计
pages.headlineEn: Assessing a Final Keeper: Count the Heartbeat in the Stats
pages.deck: 高压守门员的观察表。
pages.deckEn: An observation sheet for keepers under pressure.
pages.bodyLeft: 高压门将的评估从失球后开始：被进一球后的下一个十分钟、连续角球中的出击决策、指挥防线的有效音量——注意是有效，不是最大。二次反应和站位纪律在决赛里会被放大到可以进行为分析的程度。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Assess from the goal conceded onward: the next ten minutes, come-or-stay calls through consecutive corners, the effective volume of his command — effective, not maximum. Second reactions and positioning magnify in finals into behavioural analysis.
pages.bodyRight: 风险项：久未参赛者的比赛节奏、点球历史样本的真实性、以及准备流程的长度。有的门将开一次门球要盖十九个章，文书齐全但反击已死——决赛的节奏不等手续。请确认你要的是门卫，还是档案馆。
pages.bodyRightEn: Risks: rhythm in the long-unused, penalty-history authenticity, routine length. Some keepers need nineteen stamps for one goal kick — paperwork complete, counter dead. Finals wait for no procedure. Confirm you want a goalkeeper, not an archive.
pages.pullQuote: “评估门将请看失球之后，而不是零封之中。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Judge a keeper after conceding, not inside the clean sheet.”
pages.sidebarBody: 先丢球后的指挥；连续角球；第 85 分钟领先时的出击选择。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Command after conceding; consecutive corners; line choices when leading on 85.

pages.headline: 门将发言学：发布会上的手套哲学
pages.headlineEn: Keeper Rhetoric: Glove Philosophy at the Presser
pages.deck: 这个位置的人说话，总比扑救慢半拍才稳妥。
pages.deckEn: This position speaks safest half a beat slower than its saves.
pages.bodyLeft: 门将的发布会是这个位置的另一副手套：少说“我”，多说“我们”；不评价对方点球手的心理状态；不承诺零封；不在周三谈论命运。一位老教练的标准至今有效：最好的门将采访只有三句——球来了，我扑了，吃晚饭了。超过三句的部分，一般归公关部负责善后。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The keeper's presser is the position's other pair of gloves: less 'I', more 'we'; never assess the opposing taker's mind; never promise a clean sheet; never discuss fate on Wednesdays. An old coach's standard holds: the perfect keeper interview is three sentences — ball came, I saved it, had dinner. Anything past three goes to PR for cleanup.
pages.bodyRight: 这个位置还有自己的传承经济学：老门将带小门将，学费是失误合集，教材是膝盖和腰背的使用说明。决赛周请把话筒更多递给教练组，让门将保留内心戏——球门七米三二宽，他们的思绪没有边线，但至少可以有休赛期。休赛期的第一项规定同样是：不谈命运。
pages.bodyRightEn: The position runs its own inheritance economics: old keepers coach young; tuition is an error reel, the textbook a manual for knees and backs. In final week, give the mic to the coaches; let keepers keep the inner theatre — the goal is 7.32 metres wide, their thoughts have no touchline, but they do get an off-season. First rule there: no fate either.
pages.pullQuote: “最好的门将采访只有三句：球来了，我扑了，吃晚饭了。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The perfect keeper interview: ball came, I saved it, had dinner.”
pages.sidebarBody: 不评价对方点球手心理；不承诺零封；不在周三谈论命运。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: No assessing takers' minds; no clean-sheet promises; no fate on Wednesdays.

mag.season.51.issueTitle: 年度特刊：五十二周颁奖典礼

pages.headline: 五十二周颁奖典礼：所有笑话都有回放
pages.headlineEn: The 52-Week Awards: Every Joke Gets a Replay
pages.deck: 一年份的梗，一次发完，谢绝催更。
pages.deckEn: A year of running gags, handed out in one night.
pages.bodyLeft: 从夏天的“四十一球”到冬窗的传真机卡纸，这个赛季证明了一件事：足球里没有孤立的笑话，每个笑话都会在某个周二晚上获得续集。
pages.bodyLeftEn: From summer's '41 goals' to the winter fax jam, this season proved one thing: no football joke stands alone — every gag gets a sequel on some Tuesday night.
pages.bodyRight: 今晚我们颁发十个奖项。评委是完整比赛录像，公证处是出场名单，奖杯由一只保温杯赞助——它本赛季第四次当选“最可靠在场人员”。
pages.bodyRightEn: Tonight, ten awards. Jury: complete match footage. Notary: the teamsheet. Trophies sponsored by a thermos flask — 'most reliable presence', fourth time running.
pages.pullQuote: “回放不会嘲笑任何人，它只是记得。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The replay mocks nobody; it merely remembers.”
pages.sidebarBody: 金保温杯奖、最佳统计口径奖、年度病假奖、最佳遮挡奖、年度文书奖，以及五个正经奖项。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Golden Thermos, Best Statistical Methodology, Sick Note of the Year, Best Obstruction, Paperwork of the Year — plus five serious awards.

pages.headline: 奖项一至五：数字、杯子与缺席的第五人
pages.headlineEn: Awards 1–5: Numbers, Flasks and the Absent Fifth Man
pages.deck: 首先颁发信息核查类奖项。
pages.deckEn: First, the information-verification categories.
pages.bodyLeft: 第一座，最佳统计口径奖，授予赛季初那份“四十一球”：没有联赛名称、没有出场数、没有比赛级别，却成功让全行业的球探在接下来一年里先问口径再报价。第二座，金保温杯奖，授予那只随队多年的保温杯——它见证了落点判断比冲刺更长寿，并以全票连任“最可靠在场人员”。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Award one, Best Statistical Methodology: the '41 goals' — no league, no appearances, no level, yet it taught an industry of scouts to ask methodology before price. Award two, the Golden Thermos: the flask that has travelled with the squad for years, witness that reading a ball's drop outlives sprinting, unanimously re-elected 'most reliable presence'.
pages.bodyRight: 第三座，年度病假奖，授予“五连扑”传说里助跑前请病假的第五位主罚者：他的缺席捍卫了统计的真实性。第四座，最佳遮挡奖，授予那块挡住球衣号码的三明治，它教会我们证据也会饿。第五座，年度文书奖，由十九张表与一台卡纸传真机共享——手续齐全，反击已死。
pages.bodyRightEn: Award three, Sick Note of the Year: the fifth taker who called in sick before his run-up — his absence defended statistical truth. Award four, Best Obstruction: the sandwich over the shirt number, which taught us evidence gets hungry. Award five, Paperwork of the Year: nineteen forms and one jammed fax — procedures complete, counter-attack dead.
pages.pullQuote: “本赛季的每个笑话都在同一条战线上：先核实，再刊登。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Every joke this season stood on one line: verify first, publish second.”
pages.sidebarBody: 保温杯：“水还是温的。”三明治：缺席，由家属代领。传真机：维修中，无法到场。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: The thermos: 'Water's still warm.' The sandwich: absent, family collecting. The fax: under repair.

pages.headline: 奖项六至十：坦克、网红与检点问题
pages.headlineEn: Awards 6–10: Tanks, Influencers and the Conduct Question
pages.deck: 接下来颁发赛季人物类奖项。
pages.deckEn: Next, the season's personality categories.
pages.bodyLeft: 第六座，年度比喻奖：“时速两百公里的坦克”，一个让整个联赛边路学会让路的形容。第七座，年度滤镜奖：四百万粉丝的网红前锋，他的球技与剪辑师共享奖杯，底座刻着小字——“视频所示能力以实物为准”。第八座，年度赔率奖：十次过人九次失败的赌徒，成功的那一次已被循环播放至下赛季季前赛。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Award six, Metaphor of the Year: 'a 200 km/h tank', which taught a league's flanks to give way. Award seven, Filter of the Year: the four-million-follower striker, sharing the trophy with his editor — base engraved 'abilities as shown, subject to actual product'. Award eight, Odds of the Year: the gambler whose nine dribbles of ten fail; the one success looped into next pre-season.
pages.bodyRight: 第九座，年度委婉语奖：“私生活检点问题”，冬窗最忙碌的七个字，本刊立场不变——请以训练出勤记录代替猜测。第十座，年度限定词奖：“最年轻纪录”，纪录属实，限定词也属实，在本赛季的信息环境里，这几乎值得一座终身成就奖。
pages.bodyRightEn: Award nine, Euphemism of the Year: 'questions over private-life conduct', the window's busiest seven words — our stance: attendance records over speculation. Award ten, Qualifier of the Year: 'the youngest-ever record', record real and qualifiers real — this season, that nearly merits a lifetime award.
pages.pullQuote: “人物会过气，问题不会：明年还会有新的四十一球。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “Personalities fade; the questions don't — next year, a new 41 goals.”
pages.sidebarBody: “哪里缺人补哪里”先生、马拉松型中场，以及所有在亲属推荐栏填表的人。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Mr Plug-Any-Gap, the marathon midfielder, and all who filed under 'family recommendation'.

pages.headline: 年度球探报告：本刊接受同行评议
pages.headlineEn: The Annual Scout Report: We Submit to Peer Review
pages.deck: 核查者的成绩单，也请读者核查。
pages.deckEn: The checker's report card — readers, please check.
pages.bodyLeft: 本刊的优势自评：坚持了完整录像、双源核实、给每条传闻标注可信等级；没有一份“据传”直接登上封面而没有下文；所有笑话在刊登前均通过事实部门的幽默审查，审查标准是：先笑，后查，再笑一次。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Self-assessed strengths: full-match tape, two-source verification, a credibility grade on every rumour; no 'allegedly' hit the cover without follow-up; every joke passed the fact department's humour review pre-publication — laugh first, verify second, laugh again.
pages.bodyRight: 存疑部分也如实刊登：我们对笑话的热情偶尔跑在数据前面，个别标题比正文先到现场；明年的改进清单第一条已经写好——标题限速，核实先行。最后一条核查清单永远写着：检查核查者。
pages.bodyRightEn: Doubts, printed honestly: joke enthusiasm sometimes outran data; some headlines arrived before the copy. Next year's item one: headline speed limits, verification first. The checklist's last entry never changes: check the checkers.
pages.pullQuote: “最后一条核查清单永远写着：检查核查者。”
pages.pullQuoteEn: “The checklist's last entry never changes: check the checkers.”
pages.sidebarBody: 新赛季清单：新的数字、新的杯子、新的传真机。本刊编辑部将持续缺觉。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Next season's list: new numbers, new flasks, a new fax. The newsroom stays sleep-deprived.
